title: Built-in component catalog
description: Every built-in component a layout slot can hold, with the schema of its props. Custom components (DIAGRAM_COMPONENTS_DIR) declare their own props schema; list_components shows the installed catalog.

dock.brand.title: dock.brand
dock.brand.description: Brand mark: the layout's branding logo and/or name. Renders nothing without branding.

dock.title.title: dock.title
dock.title.description: Diagram title and subtitle (hidden when the spec sets showTitle: false).

dock.zoom.title: dock.zoom
dock.zoom.description: Zoom out, fit and zoom in buttons.

dock.walkthrough.title: dock.walkthrough
dock.walkthrough.description: Walkthrough restart and play/pause (only when the spec has steps).

dock.cost.title: dock.cost
dock.cost.description: Cost estimate link button (only when the spec has costUrl, or a step has one). A link — nothing is priced.

label.description: Button label when the spec sets no costLabel.

dock.costs.title: dock.costs
dock.costs.description: Estimate split button: the selected environment's estimate, a menu listing every entry of spec.costs (label + environment tag) and an environment switch. dock.cost turns into this automatically when costs has more than one entry.

label.description: Button label when the entry has none.

dock.language.title: dock.language
dock.language.description: Language menu (only when the spec offers more than one language).

stepCard.code.title: stepCard.code
stepCard.code.description: Code: one block (code + codeLabel) or several collapsible blocks (codeBlocks, or codeSplit: "markers") with per-block header, copy and chevron, expand/collapse all and 'Show more'.

defaultCollapsed.description: Which blocks start collapsed when a block does not say: rest (default — first open), all, none.

showLang.description: Language tag on each block header (default true).

stepCard.costPill.title: stepCard.costPill
stepCard.costPill.description: Cost estimate link pill for a step with costUrl.

label.description: Pill label when the step sets no costLabel.

sidebar.brand.title: sidebar.brand
sidebar.brand.description: Sidebar brand header: logo (layout branding) or glyph, title, truncated subtitle, dark/light toggle.

icon.description: A glyph (database, architecture, settings, chart, server, cpu, backup, swap, cloud, info, pin, clock, moon, sun, chevronLeft, chevronRight, chevronUp, chevronDown) or an AWS service name for its official icon.

sidebar.language.title: sidebar.language
sidebar.language.description: Sidebar language segmented control (only when the spec offers more than one language).

sidebar.nav.title: sidebar.nav
sidebar.nav.description: Sidebar navigation: one item per page with icon, label and an optional value badge.

sidebar.summary.title: sidebar.summary
sidebar.summary.description: Sidebar summary card pinned to the bottom: eyebrow, big value, context line, optional select (edits data), breakdown rows, totals, footer rows; collapsible.
